answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before accepting jobs, whether it sells lantern designs, sonnet commissions, or pigment formulas. Each identity needs its own deposit, so creating 1,000 active fake sellers ties up $100,000 for a month. If a seller takes payment but misses the delivery deadline, the contract forfeits its deposit. New names cannot reset that cost: each must fund a fresh bond.
